findings: STE regression in README.md: "The my-python-app application needs a database" must be "must have a database" or revert to "A database is necessary for the my-python-app application." AGENTS.md prohibits "needs."

Six image short descriptions omit the Docker concept: allure, code-quality, java, my-python-app, python, rust name only the tool purpose. The review criterion requires the first paragraph to name the Docker concept shown. Compact rewrites within the 100-byte limit are feasible for all six; see examples in the review document.

allure and web-qa: no confirmed local test pass. Both commits defer to CI due to SSL inspection on the build host. allure has functional Dockerfile changes (SHELL pipefail, WORKDIR /tmp); the review criterion requires test-pass confirmation from commit messages.

my-python-app CMD comment uses label-colon form ("JSON array form: the OS sends signals...") rather than an imperative sentence. STE requires: "Use the JSON array form. The OS then sends signals directly to Python, without a shell wrapper."
